name: fynns-ui-consume
title: Install @fynns/ui via zero-token sibling file: (machine contract)
description: Link @fynn7/ui-design-core from the public sibling ../fynns_ui_design_core (file:) and wire the Vite/tsconfig alias @fynns/ui. No NODE_AUTH_TOKEN day-to-day; GitHub Packages is publishers-only; no git submodule. Human contract + greenfield skeleton: llm/CONSUME.md.
rules: Before writing app code for @fynns/ui, read llm/CONSUME.md; look props up with `node scripts/api.mjs <Name>` instead of reading source files.

Day-to-day consume: public sibling ../fynns_ui_design_core + file: dependency @fynn7/ui-design-core + Vite/tsconfig alias @fynns/ui -> node_modules/@fynn7/ui-design-core/src/index.ts. No NODE_AUTH_TOKEN, no git submodule, no obsolete package names @fynns/ui / @fynns/ui-design-core.
Consumer .npmrc: @fynn7:registry=https://registry.npmjs.org; never commit _authToken=${NODE_AUTH_TOKEN}. E401 = leftover Packages .npmrc.
Vite resolve.dedupe [react, react-dom]; tsconfig target/lib ES2022+; vite-env.d.ts with vite/client when tsc runs against the sources.

API-only: props / children / labels; never restyle .fynns-*, never hardcode hex/px; missing capability lands in the core first, then refresh the sibling. Do not edit node_modules/@fynn7/ui-design-core.

Default chrome DestinationAppShell -> PageScroll -> Card / List / EmptyState; Dialog for modals; snackbar + SnackbarHost for transient feedback; BusyRegion / BusyScrim for loading. Rules index: llm/CONSUMER_TREATY.md; purged symbols: llm/BREAKING_PURGE.md.
Installer writes .cursor/rules/fynns-ui-consumer.mdc and AGENTS.md (from llm/consumer-AGENTS.md) when missing; re-sync the Cursor rule with --sync-consumer-rule after treaty updates.

ensureSibling.description: Clone / fast-forward the public sibling and optionally npm install the file: link + safe .npmrc (zero-token).

install.description: Default --sibling: safe .npmrc + wire Vite/tsconfig @fynns/ui + gate scripts + consumer rule/AGENTS.md. Opt-in --packages for GitHub Packages (token).

check.description: Validate dependency + .npmrc + alias + dedupe + consumer rule hash + no leftover submodule tree (exit 1 if incomplete).

wireOnly.description: Dependency already present; only patch .npmrc / Vite / tsconfig / hooks / rule files.

checkExports.description: Hard gate: every named @fynns/ui import must exist on the linked barrel.

api.description: Print props / signatures / token names on demand instead of reading source files.

checkUpdate.description: Soft notice when GitHub Packages has a newer version (wired into predev/prebuild/prepreview/postinstall).

publish.description: Optional: bump + publish to GitHub Packages (publishers). See docs/package-propagation.md.

successCriteria: vite.config.* has resolve.alias["@fynns/ui"] pointing at that entry and resolve.dedupe [react, react-dom]
tsconfig paths map @fynns/ui to the same entry; target/lib ES2022+
no git submodule left as the alias target
clone -> npm install -> npm run dev needs no NODE_AUTH_TOKEN
every named @fynns/ui import exists on the barrel (check-ui-exports)
no imports of purged symbols listed in llm/BREAKING_PURGE.md
